subject.title: fix(ci): extend frozen target hook timeout

question: Should the release-validation owners accept a five-minute hook timeout for compatibility targets in exchange for avoiding cold-run false failures?
rationale: This is a deliberate CI failure-detection tradeoff on a protected member PR; source tests establish scope but cannot choose the acceptable release-validation delay.

options.title: Accept the scoped timeout
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete if release-validation owners agree that compatibility-target hooks may wait up to five minutes before failing.

options.title: Keep the 120-second ceiling
options.body: Close or revise the change if the longer wait is unacceptable for frozen-candidate failure detection.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped timeout
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete if release-validation owners agree that compatibility-target hooks may wait up to five minutes before failing.

likelyOwner.reason: The current CI change author is the clearest routing contact in the supplied history; final acceptance belongs with the responsible release-validation reviewer.
